checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 9:16 edit with woman centred, face visible
must.why: Output is still 16:9 landscape, not 9:16. The woman is centred and her face is visible.

must.item: Full 10 s and original voice preserved in sync
must.why: The clip runs 10.1 s and has audio at normal level. Sync cannot be judged from stills.

must.item: Captions reproduce the full sentence in order, no omissions or inventions
must.why: I saw 'Today I want to show you three easy' and 'ways to make your mornings less stressful.' in order. No caption showed at 1 s, so 'Hi everyone!' was not seen.
Captions show as short one-line chunks that change between frames, not the whole transcript at once.

must.item: Clear contrast, in frame, not covering face
must.why: White text with a dark shadow sits over her torso, clear of her face and inside the frame. The thin serif font is only moderately readable over the busy background.

exact_text.read_as: No caption visible in the 1 s frame, so this text was not seen.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: 'Today I want to show you three easy' then 'ways to make your mornings less stressful.'

faults.what: Output is 16:9 landscape, not the 9:16 vertical format the item requires.
'Hi everyone!' caption not visible in the sampled 1 s frame, so it may be missing or timed differently.
Thin italic serif caption font is moderately legible on the busy background, and the captions sit over her chest and hands.

summary: The clip is a landscape captioned video with readable, well-chunked captions that stay clear of her face, but it is not 9:16 and the opening 'Hi everyone!' caption was not seen.
